text: ast-outline skill and repository AGENTS say paths may follow the command directly, but installed CLI requires the explicit outline subcommand. Document the accepted syntax to prevent a dead-end invocation.
Runtime imports omit file extensions while ast-outline needs the exact extension; a mixed lookup with a nonexistent path aborts the whole batch. Per-path diagnostics would make exploration faster.

React plan verification commands use react-doctor --scope <path>, but current React Doctor only accepts full/files/changed/lines. The command silently ignores file paths, so plans need supported changed-file syntax.
ast-outline documentation says outline accepts only paths, but unrecognized -g flags merely emits a note and no outline; validation/error should be explicit.
Source paths surfaced by ast-outline are extension-sensitive; a missing-file diagnostic after an outline request would benefit from suggested matching paths.
Jujutsu does not support git-compatible diff --check; a documented whitespace-check equivalent would avoid a dead-end validation command.
Package-scoped Vitest filters reject workspace-relative paths without a clear path-base hint; package-relative paths are required.
rtk warns that pnpm --filter is unsupported for tsc even though the package script completed; scoped typecheck behavior is ambiguous in compressed output.
ast-outline show expands unquoted multiple file paths as a shell glob-like argument, which produces a misleading note despite returning useful output.
TanStack Router packages are hoisted outside the app node_modules path assumed by search, so package-source lookup hit a missing directory before finding docs.
